correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the uniform simplex law (iid circular gaps Dirichlet(1,...,1)) and coordinate-shift identity P(S_i>t_i,i in I)=(1-sum t_i)_+^(n-1). Separating equal and unequal indices yields exactly n[(1-b)^(n-1)+(n-1)(1-a-b)_+^(n-1)-n(1-a)^(n-1)(1-b)^(n-1)]. Normalizing by n(1-b)^(n-1) gives 1-n(1-a)^(n-1)+(n-1)((1-a-b)_+/(1-b))^(n-1), strictly decreasing until b=1-a and constant thereafter; variance at b=a is positive for a<alpha_n. This proves the one-switch/plateau/all-positive trichotomy with the claimed explicit zero. Zero-covariance nonindependence follows from G_n(b)=1 implying G_n(a)=1 while G_n(a)=0 has positive probability. Expansion at a=x/n,b=y/n verifies e^(-y)-(1+xy)e^(-x-y); bracketing establishes the moving zero limit. Independently recomputed rational-grid sign and exact covariance identities for n=3..11 and checked finite grid/exponential diagnostics in inspected verify.py; bounded numerics support, not prove, infinite statements.
residual_risks: Independent bounded checks do not replace the analytic proof; scope limited to stated assumptions.
